source_accumulation_method: Dyadic spatial shell bounds at fixed tau followed by Bochner integration in tau, split into (0,tau0] and [tau0,infinity), with T->infinity only after absolute norm-tail bounds.
nested_limit_order: For each fixed tau, sum spatial kernel shells absolutely; then integrate the resulting L-infinity norm majorant in tau; only then pass T->infinity in the ancient mild formula.
local_block_definition: Spatial blocks B_sqrt(tau) and annuli 2^k sqrt(tau), plus temporal blocks near zero and infinity.
block_tail_or_convergence_theorem_requir: Explicit shell majorants sum_k 2^(2k)e^(-c4^k)<infinity and sum_k 2^(-3k)<infinity; temporal majorants M^2 tau^(-1/2) near zero and A_* tau^(-3/2) at infinity are integrable.
alternate_summation_equivalence_proof: No distinct alternate summation is claimed; finite/dyadic regrouping represents the same Bochner integral and is justified by absolute L-infinity norm convergence.
